name: SIS and BRO: The Cyborg Siblings
source:
A cute and kind of creepy sci fi visual novel RPG where you play as two robot kids and do whatever you want, even if you wanna do nothing!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860040/SIS_and_BRO_The_Cyborg_Siblings/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款可爱又令人毛骨悚然的科幻视觉小说角色扮演游戏，你可以扮演两个机器人孩子，做任何你想做的事，即使你什么都不想做！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860040/SIS_and_BRO_The_Cyborg_Siblings/]Steam[/url]]
